facts: Heavy rain overnight caused municipal sewer main surcharge.
Water entered basement through floor drain, not through windows or surface entry.
City confirmed sewer main surcharge; no failure of insured's sump pump.
note: The endorsement HO-0820 defines "Water backup" as water that backs up through sewers or drains, which matches the basement flood from the municipal sewer surcharge [HO-0820_05-24#02]. The coverage grant provides up to $10,000 per loss event with a $1,000 deductible, overriding any exclusion in HO-0304, and no listed exclusions (e.g., equipment failure or vacancy) apply to this situation [HO-0820_05-24#03].
